formal_statement: ∀ (n s : ℕ), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x : Fin n → Bool => decide ((Finset.univ.filter fun i : Fin n => x i = true).card % 2 = 1)) s → 3 * (n - 1) ≤ s
plain_statement: Every fan-in 2 circuit of AND, OR, NOT gates for the parity of n inputs has at least 3(n - 1) gates. Schnorr, Zwei lineare untere Schranken fuer die Komplexitaet Boolescher Funktionen, Computing 13, 1974 (there with free negations; here NOT gates are counted, so the bound holds a fortiori).
title: Parity of n inputs needs at least 3(n - 1) gates
